name: rel-ai-mcp
description: Rel.AI gives ChatGPT Web controlled local developer-mode repository workflows for analysis, code modification, validation, review, and release preparation.

interface.shortDescription: Local coding-agent tools for ChatGPT web
interface.longDescription: Give ChatGPT Web controlled local developer-mode workflows to analyze repositories, modify code, run validation, review task-owned changes, and prepare releases through Rel.AI MCP with explicit work sessions and server-side safeguards.
defaultPrompt: Use $rel-ai-workflow to find and fix the failing tests in the configured local repository.
Use $rel-ai-workflow to investigate this repository issue with the smallest sufficient evidence set, then implement the fix if requested.
Use $rel-ai-workflow to review only the changes owned by this task and run the appropriate validation.
Use $rel-ai-workflow to determine whether this local repository is ready to ship and report the evidence.
